title: Fill the Fridge!
description:
It’s time to fill the fridge with your friends, the Munchie, the chef, and Popo!

Become an adorable fruit spirit and keep stuffing food into the fridge.

Prove that you’re the ultimate master of organization!

Features

 Inventory Management Game: A fun and chaotic twist on classic inventory organization.

 PvP Multiplayer: Compete head-to-head with other players.

 Time-Limited Matches: Think fast and organize faster—every second counts!

 3 Game Modes: Munchie, Chef, Puzzle: Enjoy all modes in both single-player and multiplayer.

 Dozens of Magical Items: Discover and use a wide variety of magical items.

Intense BattlesPlay online with up to 4 friends, or challenge players from all over the world.

Your rivals are waiting—are you ready to prove yourself?

Items & SabotageUse a wide range of items at the perfect moment to disrupt your opponents.

Of course, there are also plenty of items that give you the upper hand!

Three Unique Game ModesChoose from Munchie, Chef, or Puzzle mode.

Practice in single-player, then show off your refined skills in online matches!

Diverse MapsExplore a variety of maps such as kitchens, beaches, and jungles.

Each map features its own unique set of pieces—keep that in mind when you play!
description_short: It’s time to fill the fridge with your friends, the Munchie, the chef, and Popo! Keep stuffing food into the fridge and prove that no one organizes better than you. All in this fun and stylish inventory management game!
